options: A part of a chromosome that codes for a trait
optionsAf: ’n Deel van ’n chromosoom wat ’n eienskap kodeer
items.explain: A gene is a section of DNA on a chromosome that codes for a particular characteristic.
items.explainAf: ŉ Geen is ’n stuk DNA op ’n chromosoom wat ’n besondere kenmerk kodeer.

items.q: A dominant allele is shown by:
items.qAf: ŉ Dominante allel word getoon deur:
items.explain: Dominant alleles are written with a capital letter, such as B, and mask recessive alleles, written as b.
items.explainAf: Dominante allele word met ’n hoofletter geskryf, soos B, en verberg resessiewe allele, geskryf as b.

items.q: Which genotype shows a plant that is heterozygous for flower colour, where purple (P) is dominant to white (p)?
items.qAf: Watter genotipe wys ’n plant wat heterosigoties is vir blomkleur, waar pers (P) dominant is oor wit (p)?
items.explain: Heterozygous means two different alleles, here one of each: Pp.
items.explainAf: Heterosigoties beteken twee verskillende allele, hier een van elk: Pp.

items.q: In a monohybrid cross Pp × Pp, what is the expected ratio of phenotypes?
items.qAf: In ’n monohibriede kruising Pp × Pp, wat is die verwagte verhouding van fenotipes?
items.explain: Three offspring show the dominant trait and one shows the recessive trait, so the phenotype ratio is 3 : 1.
items.explainAf: Drie nageslag wys die dominante eienskap en een die resessiewe eienskap, dus is die fenotipe-verhouding 3 : 1.

items.q: In a cross Bb × bb, what percentage of offspring are expected to show the recessive trait?
items.qAf: In ’n kruising Bb × bb, watter persentasie nageslag word na verwagting die resessiewe eienskap wys?
items.explain: Half the offspring will be bb, which shows the recessive trait, so 50%.
items.explainAf: Die helfte van die nageslag sal bb wees, wat die resessiewe eienskap wys, dus 50%.

items.q: Two parents both have the recessive trait and are pure-breeding (bb × bb). What fraction of their offspring will show the dominant trait?
items.qAf: Twee ouers het albei die resessiewe eienskap en is suiwer (bb × bb). Watter breuk van hul nageslag sal die dominante eienskap wys?
items.explain: All offspring will be bb, so none show the dominant trait.
items.explainAf: Alle nageslag sal bb wees, so geen wys die dominante eienskap nie.

items.q: A section of DNA that controls one characteristic.
items.qAf: ’n Deel van DNS wat een eienskap beheer.

items.q: Different forms of the same gene.
An allele that is only expressed when two copies are present.
items.qAf: ’n Alleel wat net uitgedruk word wanneer twee kopieë teenwoordig is.

items.q: The physical appearance of an organism for a characteristic.
items.qAf: Die fisiese voorkoms van ’n organisme vir ’n eienskap.

items.text: The genetic make-up of an organism, such as Tt, is its [[]]. An organism with two different alleles, such as Tt, is [[]].
items.textAf: Die genetiese samestelling van ’n organisme, soos Tt, is sy [[]]. ’n Organisme met twee verskillende allele, soos Tt, is [[]].

items.text: Humans have [[]] chromosomes in each body cell, in [[]] pairs.
items.textAf: Mense het [[]] chromosome in elke liggaamsel, in [[]] pare.

items.q: A child gets half of its chromosomes from each parent.
items.qAf: ’n Kind kry die helfte van sy chromosome van elke ouer.
items.explain: True. Each gamete has 23 chromosomes; together they make 46.
items.explainAf: Waar. Elke gameet het 23 chromosome; saam maak hulle 46.

items.q: An organism with genotype TT is heterozygous.
items.qAf: ’n Organisme met genotipe TT is heterosigoties.
items.explain: False. TT has two identical alleles, so it is homozygous.
items.explainAf: Onwaar. TT het twee identiese allele, dus is dit homosigoties.

items.q: Variation between individuals can be caused by genes and by the environment.
items.qAf: Variasie tussen individue kan deur gene en deur die omgewing veroorsaak word.
items.explain: True. For example, height depends on genes and on nutrition.
items.explainAf: Waar. Byvoorbeeld, lengte hang af van gene en van voeding.

items.q: Two heterozygous tall plants (Tt × Tt) are crossed. What percentage of the offspring are expected to be short (tt)?
items.qAf: Twee heterosigotiese lang plante (Tt × Tt) word gekruis. Watter persentasie van die nakomelinge word verwag om kort (tt) te wees?
items.explain: The Punnett square gives TT, Tt, Tt, tt: 1 out of 4 = 25% are short.
items.explainAf: Die Punnett-vierkant gee TT, Tt, Tt, tt: 1 uit 4 = 25% is kort.

items.q: In pea plants, purple flowers (P) are dominant over white flowers (p). A purple plant is crossed with a white plant and ALL the offspring are purple. Give the genotype of the purple parent and explain your answer.
items.qAf: By ertjieplante is pers blomme (P) dominant oor wit blomme (p). ’n Pers plant word met ’n wit plant gekruis en AL die nakomelinge is pers. Gee die genotipe van die pers ouer en verduidelik jou antwoord.
points: The purple parent is PP (homozygous dominant).
The white parent can only give p; if the purple parent were Pp, about half of the offspring would be white (pp).
pointsAf: Die pers ouer is PP (homosigoties dominant).
Die wit ouer kan net p gee; as die pers ouer Pp was, sou omtrent die helfte van die nakomelinge wit (pp) wees.
